# Christmas Northwest
> Professional Christmas light installation serving Seattle, Bellevue, Kirkland, Bothell, Kenmore, Woodinville, Redmond, Sammamish, and the Greater Seattle area. Owner-operated by Dylan Thornsberry. Based in Kenmore, WA.

## Services
- [Christmas Light Installation](https://christmasnw.com/services): Residential roofline lighting, tree wrapping, commercial displays, and custom designs. Projects start around $800. Design, installation, maintenance, takedown, and storage are included.

## Key Facts
- Phone: (425) 215-0935
- Email: christmaslightsnw@gmail.com
- Location: Kenmore, WA 98028
- Service area: 15+ cities across Greater Seattle and the Eastside
- Google rating: 4.9 stars with 92 reviews
- Licensed, bonded, and insured
- Founded: 2021
- Typical project scopes: clean rooflines from $800, roofline plus accents around $1,500-$1,800, full-property displays around $2,500-$3,500, and large custom displays from $4,000; commercial work is quoted individually
- Includes: design, installation, maintenance, takedown, and climate-controlled storage
